picks.name: Frenzy
picks.annotation: Very good item to resist incoming spirit damage and retaliate with bonus stats. In primarily spirit comps, pair with Spirit Resilience for 75% resist.

picks.name: Silencer
picks.annotation: Lowers enemy spirit damage output, and silences them. It builds up stacks on your Bashdown so you can hit multiple people with it at once. Very good.

picks.name: Crushing Fists
picks.annotation: Only makes sense to invest in more utility since we have Melee Charge. The stun can be really useful for interrupting channels.

picks.name: Crippling Headshot
picks.annotation: Super easy to activate shred for both damage types + antiheal. Super necessary into high resistance frontliners like Yamato, Abrams, Victor, etc.

picks.name: Colossus
picks.annotation: Fat HP increase + insane resists and more weapon damage. Very good tank item. Now gives bonus melee damage when active, which is nice.

picks.name: Siphon Bullets
picks.annotation: Good sustain and taking %max hp. Great vs tanky units.

picks.name: Phantom Strike
picks.annotation: Kill flyers - remember you can also pull flyers down with your RAM + HOLD Bashdown

picks.name: Witchmail
picks.annotation: *clink* *clink* *clink* Vs Heavy spirit dps could be good for more cooldowns!

picks.name: Greater Expansion
picks.annotation: Synergizes with all your Bashdown and Chain Gang very well and also gives you spirit resist on top.
